title: Spatially selective video

definition.title: Spatially selective video
definition.source_excerpt: A 4 s, 640×360 H.264 source was represented as four independently encoded 320×180 quadrants. All four tile streams play in Chromium. At three sampled times per tile, the tile output closely matched the corresponding region of the full-frame decode; mean absolute RGB error stayed below 0.97/255 in all twelve comparisons. Compositing all four decoded tiles back into one 640×360 canvas at 2 s produced 0.509/255 mean absolute RGB error versus the full-frame source. The largest per-channel error was concentrated in local compression/boundary differences, so this is a near-equivalent prepared representation rather than byte/pixel identity. definition.primary_metric: Complete decode/process/present cost, transfers, command work or peak live storage for identical requested output.
definition.scope_contract: Exact integer planes or an explicitly defined numerical/altered-output contract; compare the final requested region and later references where relevant.
definition.negative_control: Change stride, crop, phase, alpha, edge neighborhood or resource generation; exercise a case where the proposed shortcut is ineligible.
definition.stop_boundary: No custom decoder rewrite or GPU platform port. Include staging/readback/cache cost; reject the current implementation rather than the general idea if the executor is a proxy.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Actual required API/format for any GPU claim; CPU algebra is a separate component observation, not browser qualification.
